core.inventory.name: core.inventory
core.inventory.notes: Ported (oracle-verified): build_membership, coverage, diff, exclusions, fixture_detection, languages, lookup, reach_witness, dead_scope, module_load_abort, translation_view. PARTIAL: reach_cache (compute_fingerprint + is_valid_fingerprint ported & byte-verified; load_index/save_index NOT ported — they pickle reachability._AdjacencyIndex). IN PROGRESS (owner greenlit tree-sitter work 2026-06-29): extractors partially ported — compute_interstitial_items (the pure coverage safety net) done & oracle-verified; the tree-sitter extraction core (TreeSitterExtractor + per-language CodeItem/global/top-level extraction) and the Python-`ast` branch remain. FOUNDATION DONE: new crate mantishack_ts wraps tree-sitter 0.25 + grammar crates (python wired first), versions pinned to match the Python oracle's installed grammars (tree-sitter-python 0.25.0) so parse trees match. Oracle for verification runs from a venv at scratchpad/tsvenv (tree-sitter grammars installed there; system pip is PEP-668 blocked). EXTRACTION CORE DONE FOR PYTHON: ts_extract.rs ports the TreeSitterExtractor Python FUNCTION branch (FunctionInfo/FunctionMetadata: name, lines, signature, parameters incl. the plain-identifier-dropped quirk, decorators, return_type, class_name), 15-case byte-for-byte differential vs oracle. Python globals (_extract_globals_ts) + top-level (_extract_top_level_ts) now ported & oracle-verified too. JS function branch now ported & oracle-verified (extractor generalized to a language-parameterized walk). Remaining in extractors: the extract_items orchestration (its no-function fallback re-runs PythonExtractor's `ast` path, which needs a Python-AST strategy — only matters for files with zero functions). call_graph + reachability follow the same foundation. reach_audit depends on reachability; builder orchestrates all of them plus core.build.macro_config + core.build.rust_modules (outside core.inventory).
